رِدٌّ A support, or stay, of a thing: (M, K:) a refuge; an asylum. (Kr, M.) A poet says, “فَكُنْ لَهُ مِنَ البَلَايَا رِدَّا
يارَبِّ أَدْعُوكَ إِلَاهًا فَرْدَا
” meaning [O my Lord, I call Thee one God; then be Thou to him] a refuge from trials: and رِدَّا occurs in a reading of verse 34 of ch. xxviii. of the Kur; meaning as above; or thus written and pronounced for رِدْءًا, on account of the pause, after suppressing the ء. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
